name: King's College London
summary: A large central London university with strengths in health, law and War Studies; IB offers let you meet either a points total or an HL score.

ib.text: Offers give a total including ToK/EE or an aggregate of three HL grades, from 32 or HL 15 up to 40 or HL 21; AAA courses ask 36 or HL 18. English A at HL 4 or SL 5 meets the English requirement.

programmes.name: War Studies
programmes.about: War, conflict and security studied through history, politics, international relations, philosophy and sociology. Year one gives the causes and consequences of war; later years add specialist options, a Cold War module and a dissertation. One language module is free, and a year abroad is optional.
programmes.ib: 36 points including core, or an aggregate of 18 from three HL subjects. No subject is required; History is not asked for.
programmes.selectionNote: No test or interview is listed. The personal statement is one factor among several and should show commitment to the subject; a military reference is accepted.

flagshipSource.title: War Studies BA: a Department of War Studies degree drawing on history, politics, philosophy and sociology

programmes.name: Law LLB
programmes.about: Law studied as an intellectual discipline at the Dickson Poon School of Law in Somerset House, near the Royal Courts of Justice and Inns of Court. It has a professional skills portfolio with a legal clinic and mooting, and dual-degree and study-abroad options after year one.
programmes.ib: 38 points including core, or an aggregate of 19 from three HL subjects. No subject is required.
programmes.selectionNote: All applicants take the LNAT by 31 December 2026 (choose King's when registering). Apply before the UCAS January deadline; the personal statement is read too.

flagshipSource.title: Law LLB: the Dickson Poon School of Law, with a legal clinic, mooting and a Somerset House setting

programmes.name: Neuroscience
programmes.about: The nervous system from cells and development to physiology and pharmacology, linked to psychology and philosophy. It stresses developmental neuroscience, disorders of the nervous system and clinical aspects, with a substantial research project and optional placement or year abroad.
programmes.ib: 36 points including core, or an aggregate of 18 from three HL subjects, with 6 in HL Biology and 6 in HL Chemistry.
programmes.selectionNote: No test or interview is listed. The personal statement and reference are read alongside your grades.

flagshipSource.title: Neuroscience BSc: cell biology to psychology, with a substantial research project

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts & Humanities
faculties.line: History BA: 36 points or an HL aggregate of 18; History is generally expected but not required.

faculties.name: King's Business School
faculties.line: Business Management BSc: 38 points, with HL 6 in a humanities or social science subject (not a modern language).

faculties.name: Faculty of Dentistry, Oral & Craniofacial Sciences
faculties.line: Dentistry BDS: UCAT, then interviews from December to March; 38 points, HL 6 in Chemistry or Biology plus one more science subject.

faculties.name: Florence Nightingale Faculty of Nursing, Midwifery & Palliative Care
faculties.line: Adult Nursing BSc: 31 points, no subject required; no offer is made without an interview (November to May).

faculties.name: Faculty of Life Sciences & Medicine
faculties.line: Medicine MBBS: UCAT for everyone; 38 points with HL 6 in both Biology and Chemistry. Neuroscience BSc asks the same two HL 6s.

faculties.name: Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology & Neuroscience
faculties.line: Psychology BSc: 38 points, with HL 6 in one of Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics or Psychology.

faculties.name: Faculty of Natural, Mathematical & Engineering Sciences
faculties.line: Computer Science BSc: 39 points or an HL aggregate of 20, with HL 6 in Maths Analysis and Approaches.

faculties.name: The Dickson Poon School of Law
faculties.line: Every LLB applicant takes the LNAT by 31 December 2026; 38 points or an HL aggregate of 19; no subject is required.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Science & Public Policy
faculties.line: War Studies BA: 36 points or an HL aggregate of 18; no required subject, and a military reference is accepted.

notes: The international fee for International Relations BA is £35,900 a year in 2027-28.
International applicants pay a £2,000 deposit against the first year's fee when they firmly accept an unconditional offer.
The IB rule is either/or: you can meet an offer with the points total or with the HL aggregate, though any named subject grades still apply.
